task: Add a real C2 HTTP journey for the Articles APIs without changing production routes.
acceptanceCriteria: The C2 test starts the real Nest app and registers two users through HTTP, using the signed registration tokens without mocking controller, service, repository, database, or Redis behavior.

The test creates three tagged articles, reads detail, filters list by tag and author, and verifies total count, descending order, and all three offset pages; list responses do not expose article bodies.

The test follows the author, sees the articles in feed, favorites and unfavorites one, rejects a non-owner update without mutation, accepts an owner update, deletes the article, and verifies subsequent GET returns 404.

Registration response does not expose password or passwordHash; fixtures are unique and cleanup removes users and the unique tag in finally, using migration-verified foreign-key cascades, with usernames tracked before registration calls.
The current list API has no search parameter; unknown search is rejected. Existing E2E tests cover the 100-item limit and integration tests cover timestamp tie ordering.
Registration outbox jobs use a UUID-scoped welcome-mail queue that is removed after the app and relay shut down.
blastRadius: Test-only coverage of existing article, feed, favorite, profile follow, and registration routes
UUID-scoped rows in TEST_DATABASE_URL are cleaned with existing foreign-key cascades
One UUID-scoped Redis queue is created for C2 and removed after relay shutdown
contracts: No public route or API schema changes; runtime queue behavior defaults to welcome-mail and changes only when WELCOME_MAIL_QUEUE_NAME is explicitly set.
One test-only C2 stack PR; future API implementation work remains one API per PR.
Shared database tests must not globally truncate tables while Vitest files run in parallel.
